traitDefinitions.description: For Number of litters or clutches produced per year, we use species means, if available, or midpoints (e.g. the average between the largest and smallest known clutches) if means are not reported. Similarly, we use a midpoint of the largest and smallest mean if multiple means were reported.

The number of millimetres in width of the egg (if present).

changes: Changes in version ReptTraits dataset v1-2

We corrected mistakes found in microhabitat and habitat type for some snake species in version ReptTraits dataset v1-1 (namely Hydrophis, Emydocephalus and Scolecophidia). The new version is uploaded to the Figshare like ReptTraits dataset v1-2.
We thank Isaac Krone for comments about these mistakes, which helped to improve the quality of our dataset.
omittedReaderFields: Mass values can use length-to-mass estimates; not presented as measurements.
Juvenile-length header and definition mismatch; not used.
No venom, conservation, current distribution or population-trend update.
limits: Name and family correspondence does not establish taxonomic concept equivalence.
Single-row maxima and means do not represent complete population variation.
Source citation chains are retained, not independently reread primary-source certification.
Data guides are not complete monographs or expert-reviewed completion.
